integrity_statement: All-rank proof uses Schur orthogonality, irreducible sector decomposition, and exact signed-cycle identities. A separately executable checker verifies complete finite class operators in ranks 3 to 5; it is corroboration rather than a universal certificate. No external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete theorem for one signed-permutation conjugacy class in the natural reflection Fourier block, n>=3; it makes no claim for unions of classes or other blocks. Finite checker n=3,4,5 does not prove the all-rank theorem. Related undiscovered orbit-frame literature may imply equivalent statements.
title: Exact type-B conjugacy-class Fourier spectra and tight sampling classification
